objectiveDiagnostic.measuredFact: After/before mean output RMS is strongly reduced in present-solo, present-overlap and absent cases. No word accuracy inferred from loss or amplitude.
objectiveDiagnostic.mathematicalFact: The configured waveform term is exactly zero for an all-zero output on every absent and overlap example. On overlap it supervises only inactive intervals; positive target preservation relies solely on recognizer CE. Zero-output solo waveform loss is explicitly measured as a control.
objectiveDiagnostic.interpretation: Observed broad attenuation is consistent with a silence shortcut in the combined supervision. This does not prove the pretrained backbone cannot extract speakers, nor that ASR guidance is always invalid. Do not repair by a validation-tuned output gain or threshold.
objectiveDiagnostic.nextMethod: Use known target audio components from controlled mixtures of separate real nonoverlapping TRAIN utterances (clearly distinguish synthesized mixtures from natural overlap), add target-present waveform/source consistency supervision with negative-target cases, and freeze a new source-meeting validation split before the next trial. Do not tune learning rate or select a step on these48 examples. Preserve the untouched final holdout.
